statements: Section 6 of the Data Protection Act 2018 is headed "Meaning of 'controller'" and qualifies the definition of "controller" in Article 4(1)(7) of the UK GDPR rather than creating a free-standing definition.

Section 6(2) provides that where personal data is processed only for purposes, and by means, required by an enactment, the person on whom the obligation to process the data is imposed by that enactment is the controller.
Section 6(1) makes the UK GDPR definition of "controller" have effect subject to section 6(2), section 209 and section 210 of the Act.
